context_analysis.description: One commitment object owns a mutex-protected voter map and commit index, with immutable startIndex. Method effects are projected at mutex release: competing match and setConfiguration calls cannot observe intermediate map replacement or recalculation. Configuration replacement retains reports only for surviving IDs; removing and subsequently reintroducing an ID resets its report. Commit support is checked at advancement, not retrospectively after membership replacement. Notification delivery and caller lifecycles are outside this projection.
excluded: Terms and network participants are not state dimensions of this local object; caller initialization and report provenance remain unchecked.
Object destruction and reconstruction are excluded; monotonicity is asserted within one object lifetime.
Crash recovery, storage errors, membership admission and FSM delivery are outside the selected accumulator responsibility.
Notification channel behavior is not observed or checked.

reachability.description: A monotone history monitor records an advancement, a subsequent voter-map replacement, and a subsequent advancement in the same commitment object. This establishes ordered local interaction coverage only.
Reach a completed replacement with zero tracked voters; this is local defensive-branch coverage, not evidence of legal cluster membership.
Reach an advancement with two voters, exercising the strict-majority interpretation for an even voter count.
Reach a completed ignored report, covering nonvoter and non-increasing inputs in the search.

bundle.description: Preferred next check: execute a deterministic package-local test against newCommitment, match and setConfiguration, recording actual maps and commit values before and after calls and applying an independent counting oracle. The supplied harness includes an advancement, membership replacement, another advancement, stale and nonvoter reports, empty membership, and removed-ID reintroduction. The finite model additionally explores all serialized operation orders over three IDs and indexes 0 through 3. This checks only O_commit_accounting; it does not discharge G_committed_history or O_append_support.
bundle.behavior:
---- MODULE Behavior ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANT MaxIndex
IDs == {"a", "b", "c"}
Indexes == 0..MaxIndex
VARIABLES voters, reports, commit, start, previousCommit, previousReports, ignored, event, historyStage
vars == <<voters, reports, commit, start, previousCommit, previousReports, ignored, event, historyStage>>

ZeroReports == [i \in IDs |-> 0]

Candidate(v, r) ==
  IF v = {} THEN 0
  ELSE LET rank == (Cardinality(v) - 1) \div 2
       IN CHOOSE x \in {r[i] : i \in v} :
            /\ Cardinality({i \in v : r[i] < x}) <= rank
            /\ Cardinality({i \in v : r[i] <= x}) > rank

Recalculate(v, r) ==
  LET q == Candidate(v, r)
  IN IF v # {} /\ q > commit /\ q >= start THEN q ELSE commit

AdvanceStage(newCommit) ==
  IF newCommit > commit /\ historyStage = 0 THEN 1
  ELSE IF newCommit > commit /\ historyStage = 2 THEN 3
  ELSE historyStage

Init ==
  /\ voters \in SUBSET IDs
  /\ reports = ZeroReports
  /\ commit = 0
  /\ start \in Indexes
  /\ previousCommit = 0
  /\ previousReports = ZeroReports
  /\ ignored = FALSE
  /\ event = "initial"
  /\ historyStage = 0

Match(i, x) ==
  LET accepted == i \in voters /\ x > reports[i]
      updated == IF accepted THEN [reports EXCEPT ![i] = x] ELSE reports
      nextCommit == IF accepted THEN Recalculate(voters, updated) ELSE commit
  IN /\ reports' = updated
     /\ commit' = nextCommit
     /\ previousCommit' = commit
     /\ previousReports' = reports
     /\ ignored' = ~accepted
     /\ event' = "match_completed"
     /\ historyStage' = AdvanceStage(nextCommit)
     /\ UNCHANGED <<voters, start>>

Configure(v) ==
  LET updated == [i \in IDs |-> IF i \in v /\ i \in voters THEN reports[i] ELSE 0]
      nextCommit == Recalculate(v, updated)
  IN /\ voters' = v
     /\ reports' = updated
     /\ commit' = nextCommit
     /\ previousCommit' = commit
     /\ previousReports' = reports
     /\ ignored' = FALSE
     /\ event' = "configuration_completed"
     /\ historyStage' = IF historyStage = 1 THEN 2 ELSE AdvanceStage(nextCommit)
     /\ UNCHANGED start

Next ==
  \/ \E i \in IDs, x \in Indexes : Match(i, x)
  \/ \E v \in SUBSET IDs : Configure(v)

ObjectIdentity == "commitment-1"
HistoryAdvanced == historyStage >= 1
HistoryReconfigured == historyStage >= 2
HistoryAdvancedAgain == historyStage = 3
EmptyConfiguration == event = "configuration_completed" /\ voters = {}
EvenAdvancement == Cardinality(voters) = 2 /\ commit > previousCommit
IgnoredReport == event = "match_completed" /\ ignored

Obs == [object |-> ObjectIdentity,
        event |-> event,
        start |-> start,
        commit |-> commit,
        previousCommit |-> previousCommit,
        voterA |-> "a" \in voters,
        voterB |-> "b" \in voters,
        voterC |-> "c" \in voters,
        reportA |-> reports["a"],
        reportB |-> reports["b"],
        reportC |-> reports["c"],
        previousA |-> previousReports["a"],
        previousB |-> previousReports["b"],
        previousC |-> previousReports["c"],
        ignored |-> ignored]
====
bundle.properties:
---- MODULE Properties ----
EXTENDS Behavior

Accounting ==
  /\ commit >= previousCommit
  /\ (commit > previousCommit =>
        /\ commit >= start
        /\ 2 * Cardinality({i \in voters : reports[i] >= commit}) > Cardinality(voters))
  /\ (event = "match_completed" /\ ignored =>
        /\ reports = previousReports
        /\ commit = previousCommit)
====
bundle.initial_state: One freshly constructed commitment object; any subset of three voter IDs; all report values and commitIndex zero; caller-supplied startIndex in 0..3. The harness selects all three voters and startIndex 2.
actions: Match(i, x): project one completed mutex-serialized match call, including ignored inputs.
Configure(v): project one completed mutex-serialized setConfiguration call, including unchanged and empty voter sets.

constraints.constraint: Three distinct IDs and indexes 0..3, with startIndex independently selected from the same range.
constraints.justification: A finite search bound covering zero, single, even and odd voter counts, threshold failures, multiple advancements, stale reports and voter removal/reintroduction. It does not establish results for larger populations or uint64 extremes.

constraints.constraint: Normalize reports for absent IDs to zero while retaining voter membership separately.
constraints.justification: Absent map lookups yield zero; hasVote separately controls match acceptance. setConfiguration copies only currently retained map entries, so removal and reintroduction cannot recover an old report.

constraints.constraint: Project completed methods atomically with respect to the protected map and commitIndex.
constraints.justification: match, setConfiguration and getCommitIndex hold the same mutex. No other selected operation can observe partial map replacement or recalculation. Waiting, notification internals and incomplete calls are hidden; no termination or notification guarantee is asserted.

constraints.constraint: Preserve commitIndex across voter-set replacement unless recalculation increases it.
constraints.justification: setConfiguration replaces matchIndexes but does not reset commitIndex. The checker requires current-voter support only at advancement events.

constraints.constraint: Numeric reports and voter subsets are arbitrary local API inputs within the finite bounds.
constraints.justification: The selected scope deliberately separates local arithmetic from legal cluster histories. No report truth, membership legality or election validity is assumed.

scope.description: One commitment object, three possible voter IDs, report indexes and immutable startIndex in 0..3, arbitrarily many serialized match and voter-replacement operations. Checks local advancement, monotonicity and ignored-report preservation.
assumptions: Observations are taken after completed calls; no concurrent test callers mutate the object while it is sampled.
Absent map entries are represented as zero together with a separate membership flag.
excluded: Correct startIndex initialization by the leader
More than three IDs and indexes above 3

uncertainties: The selected unit and obligation retain unresolved semantic review conditions; this proposal does not resolve them.
No parser, TLC search, reachability check, Go compilation, experiment or calibration has been executed.
The model abstracts the sorted order statistic by its rank characterization; correspondence remains subject to executable trace checking and review.
Notification helper implementation is not supplied. Notification effects, blocking and liveness are outside the completed-call safety projection.
The arbitrary TLA checker has no supported shared observable property description; automatic checker/monitor correspondence is not established.
A passing local check cannot establish the persistence meaning of reports or G_committed_history.

scope.description: At each completed operation in one bounded commitment-object history, commitIndex is nondecreasing; advancements reach startIndex and have strict-majority current report support; ignored reports preserve report values and commitIndex.
excluded: Retroactive support of a retained commit under replacement membership

observation.description: Direct scalar projections of actual snapshots under the commitment mutex and the saved immediately preceding snapshot. Missing map entries project to zero with explicit membership flags. Event names identify calls that returned. No cluster state or durable storage is inferred.

harness.description: A deterministic test calls the actual local accumulator implementation. It emits the constructor state before mutation and snapshots after each completed call. Its independent oracle counts supporting voters rather than reproducing the implementation's sorting algorithm. Errors are reported after emitting the relevant actual observation.
semantic_changes: Adds a package-local test and read-only snapshots under the existing mutex; no target protocol code is edited.
Uses direct serialized local calls and a buffered notification channel, without constructing a Raft cluster.
Selects numeric reports and voter subsets for local API coverage; these are not asserted to be legal cluster histories.
Does not observe notifications or emulate persistence, recovery, asynchronous RPCs or crash schedules.

legality.derivation: The selected methods accept Configuration values and numeric reports, serialize map operations with their own mutex, ignore absent or non-increasing reports, and explicitly handle an empty voter map. Direct package-local calls therefore exercise the selected local responsibility. No storage failure or network schedule is introduced.
legality.applicability: Local accumulator arithmetic and filtering only. Empty configurations and synthetic reports are defensive/API inputs, not claimed legal membership transitions or truthful persisted-history reports.
unresolved: The notification helper is outside the supplied source and outside the checked consequence.
The unit's semantic readiness remains unreviewed.
Automatic monitor correspondence is not supplied.
alternatives: A cluster-level investigation would require report producers, membership activation and notification consumers, which this experiment deliberately leaves unchecked.
